outputs.explanation: Panel A shows a time-lapse series of phase contrast micrographs (mock-treated and saccharin-treated) with time points labeled beneath each image; it is not a quantitative plot with axes, so axis gap labeling does not apply.
Panel B shows phase contrast and fluorescence micrographs at different time points (0, 60, 90 min); it is not a quantitative plot with axes.
Panel C shows a time-lapse micrograph series (0, 20, 30, 45 min) with fluorescence overlay; it is not a quantitative plot with axes.
